column2:
kangaroo(n.)袋鼠
(無詞性變化)
red kangaroo 紅袋鼠
baby kangaroo 袋鼠幼崽
A kangaroo can leap great distances with its powerful hind legs.
(袋鼠可以用強壯的後腿跳躍很長的距離。)
The baby kangaroo stayed safely inside its mother's pouch.
(小袋鼠安全地待在媽媽的育兒袋裡。)

keyboard(n.)鍵盤
keyboardist(n.)鍵盤樂手
computer keyboard 電腦鍵盤
keyboard shortcut 鍵盤快捷鍵
He cleaned the dust between the keys of his computer keyboard.
(他清理了電腦鍵盤按鍵之間的灰塵。)
Learning keyboard shortcuts can greatly improve your typing speed.
(學習鍵盤快捷鍵可以大幅提升你的打字速度。)

kidney(n.)腎臟
(無詞性變化)
kidney disease 腎臟疾病
kidney transplant 腎臟移植
Drinking enough water every day helps maintain healthy kidneys.
(每天補充足夠的水分有助於維持腎臟健康。)
The patient is waiting for a suitable donor for a kidney transplant.
(該名病患正在等待合適的捐贈者進行腎臟移植。)

kilometer(n.)公里
(無詞性變化)
per kilometer 每公里
square kilometer 平方公里
The school is about two kilometers away from my house.
(學校離我家大約有兩公里的距離。)
The speed limit on this highway is one hundred kilometers per hour.
(這條高速公路的速限是每小時一百公里。)

kindergarten(n.)幼兒園
kindergartner(n.)幼兒園學童
attend kindergarten 就讀幼兒園
kindergarten teacher 幼兒園老師
Children usually start kindergarten at around five years old.
(孩童通常在五歲左右開始就讀幼兒園。)
The kindergarten teacher planned fun activities to keep the kids engaged.
(幼兒園老師規劃了有趣的活動來吸引孩子們參與。)

kingdom(n.)王國、界(生物分類)
king(n.)國王
kingship(n.)王位、王權
United Kingdom 英國(聯合王國)
animal kingdom 動物界
The fairy tale tells a story of a prosperous and peaceful kingdom.
(這篇童話講述了一個繁榮且和平的王國的故事。)
Lions are often considered the kings of the animal kingdom.
(獅子通常被認為是動物界的王者。)

kit(n.)成套工具、配套元件
(無詞性變化)
first-aid kit 急救箱
tool kit 工具組
Every home should have a basic first-aid kit in case of emergencies.
(每個家庭都應該準備基本急救箱以備不時之需。)
He bought a model airplane kit and spent hours putting it together.
(他買了一組模型飛機套件，並花了數小時組裝。)

knight(n.)騎士、爵士
knighthood(n.)騎士頭銜
brave knight 勇敢的騎士
knight in shining armor 救星、救難英雄
The brave knight fought valiantly to protect his kingdom.
(那位英勇的騎士英勇奮戰以保護他的王國。)
She was waiting for a knight in shining armor to rescue her from trouble.
(她在等待一位救星出現，將她從困境中拯救出來。)

knit(v./n.)編織、毛線衣
knitting(n.)編織物
knitted(adj.)針織的
knit a sweater 編織毛衣
close-knit 緊密團結的
My grandmother likes to knit warm scarves for us in winter.
(我祖母喜歡在冬天為我們編織溫暖的圍巾。)
They grew up in a close-knit community where everyone helped each other.
(他們在一個彼此互助的緊密社區中長大。)

knot(n./v.)結、打結
knotty(adj.)多節的、棘手的
tie a knot 打結
tie the knot 結婚
Make sure to tie a tight knot so that the boat will not drift away.
(務必打一個緊緊的結，以免船隻漂走。)
After dating for seven years, they finally decided to tie the knot.
(交往七年後，他們終於決定步入禮堂結婚。)

koala(n.)無尾熊
(無詞性變化)
koala bear 無尾熊
cuddle a koala 擁抱無尾熊
The koala spends most of its day sleeping on eucalyptus trees.
(無尾熊一整天的大部分時間都在尤加利樹上睡覺。)
Australia is famous for its unique wildlife, such as the koala and kangaroo.
(澳洲以其獨特的野生動物聞名，例如無尾熊和袋鼠。)

label(n./v.)標籤、貼標籤於
(無詞性變化)
warning label 警告標籤
price label 價格標籤
Always read the nutrition label before buying packaged food.
(在購買包裝食品之前，務必閱讀營養標籤。)
You should not label people based on stereotypes.
(你不應該根據刻板印象給人們貼上標籤。)

lace(n./v.)蕾絲、鞋帶、繫鞋帶
lacy(adj.)蕾絲的
shoe laces 鞋帶
tie one's laces 繫鞋帶
The bride wore an elegant white gown trimmed with delicate lace.
(新娘穿著一件飾有精緻蕾絲的優雅白紗禮服。)
He knelt down on the sidewalk to tie his loose shoe laces.
(他在人行道上蹲下身子繫緊鬆開的鞋帶。)

ladder(n.)梯子
(無詞性變化)
climb a ladder 爬梯子
career ladder 職場晉升階梯
He used a tall ladder to clean the leaves out of the roof gutter.
(他用一把長梯清理屋頂排水溝裡的落葉。)
She worked diligently for ten years to climb the corporate career ladder.
(她勤勉地工作了十年，在企業晉升階梯上步步高升。)

lately(adv.)最近、近來
late(adj./adv.)遲的、晚的
just lately 就在最近
as of lately 最近以來
Have you seen any good movies lately?
(你最近有看過什麼好看的電影嗎？)
She has been feeling under great pressure at work lately.
(她近來在工作上感到壓力很大。)

laughter(n.)笑聲、歡笑
laugh(v./n.)笑
laughable(adj.)可笑的
burst into laughter 爆發笑聲
roar of laughter 哄堂大笑
The room was filled with joy and laughter during the family party.
(在家庭聚會期間，房間裡充滿了歡樂與笑聲。)
His funny impression of the teacher made everyone burst into laughter.
(他模仿老師的滑稽模樣讓每個人都哄堂大笑。)

laundry(n.)待洗衣物、洗衣店
launder(v.)洗滌、洗黑錢
do the laundry 洗衣服
laundry detergent 洗衣精
I usually do the laundry on Sunday mornings so my clothes are ready for school.
(我通常在週日早上洗衣服，這樣上學要穿的衣服就準備好了。)
He hung the wet laundry outside on the balcony to dry in the sun.
(他把洗好的濕衣服晾在陽台外曬太陽。)

lawn(n.)草坪、草地
(無詞性變化)
mow the lawn 修剪草坪
front lawn 前院草坪
My father spends every Saturday morning mowing the front lawn.
(我父親每週六早上都花時間修剪前院的草坪。)
The children enjoyed having a picnic and playing games on the green lawn.
(孩子們喜歡在綠油油的草坪上野餐和玩遊戲。)

leak(n./v.)漏洞、洩漏
leakage(n.)滲漏、洩漏
leaky(adj.)有漏洞的
gas leak 瓦斯外洩
water leak 漏水
The old water pipe began to leak after the freezing winter storm.
(在嚴寒的冬季風暴過後，老舊的水管開始漏水。)
Important confidential documents were leaked to the press last night.
(重要的機密文件昨晚被洩漏給了媒體。)

leap(n./v.)跳躍、躍進
(無詞性變化)
leap year 閏年
leap of faith 放手一搏、大膽一試
The cat made a graceful leap from the table onto the top of the bookshelf.
(那隻貓優雅地從桌上一躍跳到了書架頂端。)
Taking this new job was a leap of faith for her career.
(接受這份新工作是她職業生涯中的一次大膽嘗試。)

learning(n.)學習、學問
learn(v.)學習
learned(adj.)博學的
lifelong learning 終身學習
learning process 學習過程
Making mistakes is an unavoidable part of the learning process.
(犯錯是學習過程中不可避免的一部分。)
Online courses have made lifelong learning much more accessible to everyone.
(線上課程讓每個人都更容易實踐終身學習。)

leather(n.)皮革
leathery(adj.)像皮革的、粗糙的
leather jacket 皮夾克
genuine leather 真皮
He bought a stylish brown leather jacket for the cold autumn days.
(他買了一件帥氣的棕色皮夾克來度過寒冷的秋日。)
These expensive shoes are made of high-quality genuine leather.
(這雙昂貴的鞋子是由優質真皮製成的。)

leisure(n.)閒暇、休閒
leisurely(adj./adv.)悠閒的、悠閒地
leisure time 閒暇時間
at one's leisure 有空時、閒暇時
In his leisure time, he enjoys reading novels and listening to classical music.
(在閒暇時間，他喜歡閱讀小說和聆聽古典音樂。)
You can review this contract at your leisure and sign it tomorrow.
(您可以在有空時審閱這份合約，並在明天簽署。)

lemonade(n.)檸檬水
(無詞性變化)
glass of lemonade 一杯檸檬水
lemonade stand 檸檬水攤位
Nothing is more refreshing on a hot summer afternoon than an icy glass of lemonade.
(在炎熱的夏日午後，沒有什麼比一杯冰涼的檸檬水更消暑了。)
The kids set up a lemonade stand on the street corner to raise money for charity.
(孩子們在街角擺了一個檸檬水攤位，為慈善機構募款。)

leopard(n.)花豹、豹
(無詞性變化)
snow leopard 雪豹
spots of a leopard 豹的斑點
The leopard is famous for its speed, agility, and spotted coat.
(花豹以其速度、敏捷度以及斑紋皮毛聞名。)
A leopard can easily drag heavy prey up into a tall tree.
(花豹可以輕鬆地將沉重的獵物拖到高高的樹上。)

lettuce(n.)萵苣、生菜
(無詞性變化)
head of lettuce 一球萵苣
crisp lettuce 爽脆的生菜
She made a fresh salad with crisp lettuce, sliced tomatoes, and cucumber.
(她用爽脆的生菜、番茄切片和小黃瓜做了一道新鮮沙拉。)
Would you like an extra slice of cheese and some lettuce in your burger?
(你的漢堡裡想要多一片起司和一些生菜嗎？)

liberty(n.)自由
liberate(v.)解放、使自由
liberation(n.)解放
Statue of Liberty 自由女神像
religious liberty 宗教自由
The Statue of Liberty is a worldwide symbol of freedom and democracy.
(自由女神像是全球公認的自由與民主象徵。)
Citizens fought courageously for their civil liberties and equal rights.
(公民們英勇奮戰，為了爭取自身的公民自由與平等權利。)

lick(v./n.)舔、舐
(無詞性變化)
lick one's lips 舔嘴唇
give a lick 舔一下
The friendly puppy ran up and began to lick my face enthusiastically.
(那隻親人的小狗跑過來，熱情地舔我的臉。)
The little boy licked his melting ice cream before it dripped on his shirt.
(小男孩在冰淇淋滴到襯衫之前趕緊舔了一口融化的冰淇淋。)

lifetime(n.)一生、終身
(無詞性變化)
opportunity of a lifetime 一生一次的機會
in one's lifetime 在某人一生中
Winning a trip around the world was truly the opportunity of a lifetime.
(贏得環遊世界的旅行確實是一生難得的良機。)
He dedicated his entire lifetime to researching renewable energy sources.
(他將畢生精力都奉獻給了再生能源的研究。)

lighthouse(n.)燈塔
(無詞性變化)
lighthouse keeper 燈塔管理員
beam of a lighthouse 燈塔光束
The lighthouse on the cliff warned passing ships of the hazardous rocks below.
(懸崖上的燈塔警告過往船隻注意下方的危險暗礁。)
The beacon from the lighthouse guided the fishermen safely back to the harbor.
(燈塔的光芒引導著漁民安全返回港口。)

lightning(n.)閃電
(無詞性變化)
flash of lightning 一道閃電
struck by lightning 被雷擊中
A flash of lightning lit up the entire night sky during the thunderstorm.
(雷雨交加之際，一道閃電照亮了整片夜空。)
The old oak tree was struck by lightning and split down the middle.
(那棵老橡樹被閃電擊中，從中間裂成了兩半。)

lily(n.)百合花
(無詞性變化)
water lily 睡蓮
white lily 白百合
The white lily is often regarded as a symbol of pure love and innocence.
(白百合常被視為純潔愛情與天真無邪的象徵。)
Beautiful water lilies were floating peacefully across the surface of the pond.
(美麗的睡蓮平靜地漂浮在池塘水面上。)

limb(n.)肢、臂、大樹枝
(無詞性變化)
upper limbs 上肢
tree limb 大樹枝
Regular stretching exercises help keep your limbs flexible and strong.
(規律的伸展運動有助於保持四肢靈活與強健。)
A heavy tree limb snapped and fell onto the car during the gale.
(大風中，一根粗重的大樹枝斷裂並掉落在汽車上。)

litter(n./v.)垃圾、亂扔垃圾、一窩(幼獸)
(無詞性變化)
litter bin 垃圾桶
drop litter 亂扔垃圾
People who drop litter in the public park will be fined heavily.
(在公園亂丟垃圾的人將被處以重罰。)
Our cat gave birth to a healthy litter of five adorable kittens yesterday.
(我們的貓昨天生了一窩共五隻健康的可愛小貓。)

lively(adj.)充滿活力的、生氣勃勃的
live(v./adj.)居住、活的
liveliness(n.)活力
lively discussion 熱烈的討論
lively imagination 豐富活躍的想像力
The professor encouraged a lively discussion among the students in class.
(教授在課堂上鼓勵學生之間進行熱烈的討論。)
Despite her old age, she still retains a lively and cheerful personality.
(儘管年事已高，她仍然保持著活潑開朗的性格。)

loaf(n.)一條(麵包)
loaves(n.)麵包條(複數)
loafer(n.)遊手好閒者
a loaf of bread 一條麵包
meat loaf 肉捲、肉糕
She bought a loaf of freshly baked whole wheat bread from the bakery.
(她從烘焙坊買了一條剛出爐的全麥麵包。)
Half a loaf is better than no bread when you are truly hungry.
(聊勝於無；肚子餓時，半條麵包總比完全沒有麵包好。)

lobby(n./v.)大廳、遊說
lobbyist(n.)遊說者
hotel lobby 飯店大廳
lobby for 遊說支持
We agreed to meet our tour guide in the hotel lobby at eight o'clock.
(我們約定好八點在飯店大廳與導遊會合。)
Environmental groups are actively lobbying for stricter laws against pollution.
(環保團體正積極遊說制定更嚴格的反污染法規。)

locate(v.)找出...的位置、座落於
location(n.)位置、地點
located(adj.)位於的
be located in 位於
locate the problem 找出問題所在
The rescue team used GPS devices to locate the missing hikers on the mountain.
(搜救隊利用 GPS 設備在山上找出了失蹤登山客的位置。)
The new library is conveniently located near the central train station.
(新圖書館地理位置便利，就座落在中央火車站附近。)

location(n.)位置、地點
locate(v.)找出位置、使座落
prime location 黃金地段
current location 目前位置
The restaurant is situated in a prime location with a scenic ocean view.
(這家餐廳位於黃金地段，享有美麗的海景。)
Please enable GPS on your mobile phone to share your current location.
(請在手機上開啟 GPS 以分享您目前的位置。)

lock(n./v.)鎖、鎖上
locked(adj.)上鎖的
unlock(v.)解鎖、開鎖
lock the door 鎖門
under lock and key 妥善鎖藏
Remember to lock the front door and windows before leaving home.
(離家前記得將大門和窗戶鎖好。)
Important contracts and valuables should be kept safely under lock and key.
(重要合約和貴重物品應當妥善鎖藏保管。)

log(n./v.)原木、航海日誌、記錄
logger(n.)伐木工人
logging(n.)伐木業
log cabin 小木屋
log into 登入
They built a cozy log cabin in the woods to spend their winter vacation.
(他們在森林裡建了一座溫馨的小木屋來度過寒假。)
You need to enter your username and password to log into your account.
(你需要輸入使用者名稱和密碼才能登入你的帳號。)

lollipop(n.)棒棒糖
(無詞性變化)
strawberry lollipop 草莓棒棒糖
suck a lollipop 舔棒棒糖
The doctor gave the little girl a sweet lollipop after her vaccination.
(醫生在小女孩打完疫苗後給了她一支甜甜的棒棒糖。)
He bought a colorful strawberry lollipop for his younger brother at the candy store.
(他在糖果店為弟弟買了一支色彩繽紛的草莓棒棒糖。)

loose(adj.)鬆的、寬鬆的、未束縛的
loosen(v.)鬆開、放寬
loosely(adv.)寬鬆地
loose clothing 寬鬆衣物
break loose 掙脫、逃脫
You should wear loose and comfortable clothing when exercising outdoors.
(在戶外運動時，你應該穿著寬鬆舒適的衣服。))
The fierce dog broke loose from its chain and ran into the backyard.
(那隻兇猛的狗掙脫了鐵鍊，跑進了後院。)

lord(n.)貴族、領主、主
lordship(n.)貴族統治、大人
feudal lord 封建領主
Lord of the Rings 魔戒
In medieval times, peasants worked on the land owned by the noble lord.
(在中世紀，農民在貴族領主擁有的土地上耕作。)
The brave warriors swore an oath of eternal loyalty to their lord.
(勇敢的戰士們向他們的領主宣誓永恆效忠。)

loser(n.)輸家、失敗者
lose(v.)輸、失去
loss(n.)損失
good loser 有風度的輸家
sore loser 輸不起的人
Sports teach us how to be a gracious winner and a good loser.
(運動教會我們如何做一個有風度的贏家，以及輸得起的人。)
Nobody likes playing games with a sore loser who complains constantly.
(沒有人喜歡和一個總是抱怨、輸不起的人一起玩遊戲。)

lover(n.)情人、愛好者
love(v./n.)喜愛、愛
lovely(adj.)可愛的
music lover 音樂愛好者
nature lover 大自然愛好者
As a dedicated nature lover, she spends almost every weekend hiking in the mountains.
(身為一個熱愛大自然的人，她幾乎每個週末都在登山。)
The famous concert drew thousands of enthusiastic classical music lovers.
(這場著名的音樂會吸引了成千上萬熱情的古典音樂愛好者。)

luggage(n.)行李
(無詞性變化)
hand luggage 手提行李
pack luggage 收拾行李
Please make sure your hand luggage fits into the overhead compartment on the plane.
(請確保您的手提行李能放進飛機上的頭頂行李架置物箱中。)
She carefully packed her luggage the evening before departure.
(她在出發前一天晚上仔細地收拾好了行李。)

lung(n.)肺、肺部
(無詞性變化)
lung cancer 肺癌
healthy lungs 健康的肺部
Smoking causes severe damage to human lungs and increases the risk of heart disease.
(吸煙會對人體的肺部造成嚴重損害，並增加心臟病的風險。)
The excited fans shouted at the top of their lungs when their team scored a goal.
(當球隊進球時，興奮的球迷們竭盡全力扯開嗓子高聲歡呼。)
